It calls itself “%1$s” at %2$s. Anyone on this network can announce a name, so only type a PIN that Pocketdesk on your own computer is showing right now. Scanning its pairing code instead makes sure it is that computer.
Needs a Linux or Windows computer running the Pocketdesk service on your network.

Let other apps choose a computer
An automation app (Tasker and the like) may name which saved computer its share goes to. Off: shares go to the last computer used

Automation apps (Tasker and the like) hear when a session starts or ends, a file or link arrives, files finish sending, or a task ends. Any app may listen, so they hear only which computer, what kind, and a few facts (a file\'s type and size, a task\'s name and exit code): no file names, links or task output
Only files another app shares can be sent, not a path to one
No saved computer has that address

A file that stops part way is sent again up to 3 times, continuing where it stopped; with no network it first waits up to 3 minutes for one
Send and receive files with a computer reached from away, on the same link. The computer may turn this off too

How far the cursor moves for each finger movement in trackpad mode

Use a connected game controller on the computer
